cand.title: 2026 Ci2i Symposium
cand.organizationName: UHN Collaborative Centre for Immunology to Immunotherapy / EPIC
cand.excerpt: In-person full-day scientific symposium at Delta Hotels Toronto, immediately following the Canadian Cancer Immunotherapy Consortium Annual Meeting, with national and international academic speakers, interdisciplinary networking, and a reception.

findings.namedBuyers: No named hotel buyer or contracting authority verified. Ksenia Meteleva is a verified conference partnership contact; Tracy McGaha is a historically verified symposium planning chair, not a verified accommodation buyer.
findings.futureEdition: None announced: no next officially announced Ci2i Symposium edition on or after 2026-12-06 was located in the official sources reviewed for the horizon through June 2028, as of 2026-11-15. Future start/end dates, venue, city and region remain unverified.
findings.venueCommitments: Historical only: Delta Hotels Toronto hosted the announced 2026 Ci2i Symposium on October 23, 2026. No next-edition venue commitment was located. The October 21–22 dates concern the separate CCIC meeting, not Ci2i.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Future hotel sourcing is unconfirmed. The historical 2026 joint event website stated that attendees were responsible for booking directly with hotels unless otherwise indicated; this does not establish an open future room block.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Retain NO_VERIFIED_FUTURE_DATE. Ask the published Ci2i symposium contact, ci2isymposium@gmail.com, whether the next edition is approved and request exact dates, city, venue and the accommodation decision-maker before treating this as a dated sales opportunity. Do not carry the October 2026 venue forward.
